aboutText: Based in Yarraville, All Stripped has removed over 320,000 square metres of tiles and 472,000 square metres of other surfaces, equivalent to 3,600 houses. With more than 7,650 bathrooms and kitchens stripped, we bring unmatched experience and state-of-the-art equipment to every job. Our team ensures efficient and safe demolition for residential and commercial projects across Melbourne's west.
